events.summary: Wezna summons Teferi and Jabari to Aku; Teferi learns Kaervek escaped and General Mageta was injured.
events.quote: Teferi learned that Kaervek had escaped his prison and that General Mageta had been injured

events.summary: Wezna tasks Jabari with leading the army until the general recovers.
events.quote: she tasked Jabari with leading the army until the general's recovery

events.summary: Wezna reveals the Wanderer to Teferi, releasing her from an amber prison.
events.quote: using an amber prison to release her from stasis

events.summary: Wrenn and Eight open a portal to Zhalfir revealing New Phyrexia; Wezna is cautious but reassured by Teferi.
events.quote: When Wrenn and Eight opened a portal to her plane

events.summary: Wezna leads an army of warriors and mages through the portal to fight the Phyrexians.
events.quote: leading an army of warriors and mages through the portal to aid in the battle against the Phyrexians
